rows.text: completes the sale of its **49% stake in HKR Roadways to Cube Highways for Rs 57.32 crore received**, a filing 68 minutes earlier having estimated about Rs 200 crore plus a WPI-contingent Rs 48 crore

completes its purchase of **23.00% of HKR Roadways from Kotak Special Situations Fund**, a Hyderabad-Karimnagar-Ramagundam BOT toll road; the consideration is to be decided at consummation and no value is disclosed.
